thesis: The primary conversion mechanism on this site is the coverage check funnel, but it is being diluted by competing CTAs, duplicate forms, and premature pricing display, causing users to hesitate or abandon before qualification.

findings.title: Value proposition fragmented
findings.summary: Three competing h1 messages dilute the value proposition above the fold.
findings.problem: Three competing h1 messages dilute the value proposition above the fold.
findings.recommended_change: h1: Reliable Internet That Works Anywhere in the U.S.; cta: CHECK COVERAGE; notes: Consolidate into one clear value proposition.
findings.evidence: The page's main headline reads “Reliable Internet That Works Anywhere in the U.S”. | The page's main headline reads “Internet That Just Works”. | The page's main headline reads “Let's Get You the Right Internet”.
findings.opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 0.5-2.0% relative lift

findings.title: Qualification language vague
findings.summary: CTAs ask to check coverage but do not explain what qualification means, leaving visitors uncertain.
findings.problem: CTAs ask to check coverage but do not explain what qualification means, leaving visitors uncertain.
findings.recommended_change: h1: Let's Get You the Right Internet; cta: CHECK COVERAGE; notes: Add explanatory sentence near CTAs.
findings.evidence: 7 distinct calls to action compete on the same page: “CHECK COVERAGE”, “CHECK IF IT WORKS AT MY ADDRESS”, “SEE MY OPTIONS”, “GET STARTED”, “START CHAT”, “SEE WHAT I QUALIFY FOR”, “CHECK MY COVERAGE”. | A section heading reads “You qualify for everything”.
findings.opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 0.5-2.0% relative lift

findings.title: Competing CTAs split funnel
findings.summary: Multiple competing CTAs fragment the primary path, creating ambiguity about which action advances the user.
findings.problem: Multiple competing CTAs fragment the primary path, creating ambiguity about which action advances the user.
findings.recommended_change: h1: Reliable Internet That Works Anywhere in the U.S.; cta: CHECK COVERAGE (primary), de-emphasize secondary CTAs; notes: Consolidate coverage-check CTAs into one consistent primary action label.
findings.evidence: CHECK COVERAGE | CHECK IF IT WORKS AT MY ADDRESS | SEE MY OPTIONS | GET STARTED | START CHAT | SEE WHAT I QUALIFY FOR | CHECK MY COVERAGE
findings.opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 2.0-8.0% relative lift

findings.title: Duplicate forms create ambiguity
findings.summary: Two identical CONTINUE forms on the same page create ambiguity about the intended next step.
findings.problem: Two identical CONTINUE forms on the same page create ambiguity about the intended next step.
findings.recommended_change: h1: Let's Get You the Right Internet; cta: CONTINUE (single); notes: Render a single coverage-check form per page.
findings.evidence: Two identical CONTINUE forms appear on the same pages
findings.opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 2.0-8.0% relative lift

findings.title: Pricing shown before qualification
findings.summary: Prices displayed before coverage qualification cause users to self-select out based on sticker price.
findings.problem: Prices displayed before coverage qualification cause users to self-select out based on sticker price.
findings.recommended_change: h1: Reliable Internet That Works Anywhere in the U.S.; cta: CHECK COVERAGE; notes: Move pricing display to after coverage qualification.
findings.evidence: Prices shown on the page: $99.95/month $129.95/month $99.95/Mo $99.95/month $129.95/month $99.95 | A section heading reads “$99.95 /month”. | A section heading reads “$129.95 /month”.
findings.opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 1.0-5.0% relative lift

findings.title: Pricing ambiguity near form
findings.summary: Conflicting price points and fees near the CONTINUE form create uncertainty about commitment.
findings.problem: Conflicting price points and fees near the CONTINUE form create uncertainty about commitment.
findings.recommended_change: h1: Let's Get You the Right Internet; cta: CONTINUE; notes: Clarify which price applies and disclose fees.
findings.evidence: A section heading reads “$99.95 /month”. | A section heading reads “$129.95 /month”. | A section heading reads “$0.00 (one-time)”. | A section heading reads “$99.99 (one-time)”.
findings.opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 0.5-2.0% relative lift

findings.title: Repeated identical headings
findings.summary: Identical h1 headings across pages provide no distinct navigation cues.
findings.problem: Identical h1 headings across pages provide no distinct navigation cues.
findings.recommended_change: h1: Unique descriptive h1 per page; cta: CHECK COVERAGE; notes: Give each page a unique h1.
findings.evidence: The page's main headline reads “Let's Get You the Right Internet”. | The page's main headline reads “What Best Describes Your Time on the Road?”. | The page's main headline reads “How Do You Use the Internet at Home?”.
findings.opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 0.5-2.0% relative lift

findings.title: Conflicting page titles
findings.summary: The page title misleads visitors about content, breaking navigation scent.
findings.problem: The page title misleads visitors about content, breaking navigation scent.
findings.recommended_change: h1: Let's Get You the Right Internet; cta: CHECK COVERAGE; notes: Update title to accurately describe content.
findings.evidence: The browser title reads “How Nomad Internet Works - YouTube”. | The page's main headline reads “Let's Get You the Right Internet”.
findings.opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 1.0-5.0% relative lift

findings.title: Guarantee claims lack backing
findings.summary: The 'SHOP WITH CONFIDENCE' claim lacks visible guarantee details, undermining trust.
findings.problem: The 'SHOP WITH CONFIDENCE' claim lacks visible guarantee details, undermining trust.
findings.recommended_change: h1: Let's Get You the Right Internet; cta: CHECK COVERAGE; notes: Add explicit guarantee terms under heading.
findings.evidence: A section heading reads “SHOP WITH CONFIDENCE”. | A section heading reads “Real Stories from Real Users”. | A section heading reads “Why Nomad?”.
findings.opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 0.5-2.0% relative lift
